fusions.name: Corroding Jab
fusions.desc: A jab that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pellet Shot
fusions.desc: Slings a mould-hardened pellet at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Verdigris Shell
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Layered Rind
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.
